issues.description: Problem statement requires that the function 'start_app' is the global entry point, but both the template and the solution declare 'main' as global (and the template only defines 'main'). The solution does include a 'start_app' label, but it is not declared global and contains only a trivial 'ret'. This mismatch between the specified entrypoint ('start_app') and the actual global symbol in template and solution will confuse students about which symbol to implement/modify and may prevent the program from using the intended entrypoint.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the entrypoint consistent across all artifacts. Either (A) change the template and solution to declare 'start_app' as the global entrypoint (replace 'global main' with 'global start_app' and move/implement the program startup code under the 'start_app' label), or (B) update the problem statement to require 'main' as the global entrypoint. Preferable fix to match the spec: in template_repository/helloWorld.asm replace 'global main' with 'global start_app' and add a 'start_app' label that contains (or jumps into) the intended startup code; in solution_repository/helloWorld.asm declare 'global start_app' (instead of 'global main') and ensure 'start_app' contains the program's entry instructions.

issues.description: The problem statement requires the global entry point to be named `start_app`, but both the template and the provided solution use `main` as the global symbol. In the template `global main` is declared and `main:` is the entry label; the solution also declares `global main` and defines `main:` (while `start_app:` exists but is not made global). This inconsistent naming for the same conceptual entity (the program's global entry point) will confuse students: they are instructed to make `start_app` the global entry, yet the starter code and reference implementation expose `main` as the actual global entry symbol.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the entry-point identifier consistent across all artifacts. Either (A) change the problem statement to require `main` as the global entry point, or (B) update the template and solution to use `start_app` as the global entry point. Recommended: in both template_repository/helloWorld.asm and solution_repository/helloWorld.asm declare `global start_app` and ensure the entry label is `start_app` (or have `main` call into a global `start_app`), so the code matches the problem requirement and removes student confusion.
